spectators.label: Retro tin robot
spectators.look: boxy silver tin robot with a square head, two round red light-bulb eyes, a grille mouth and an antenna topped with a red ball, a chest panel of colored dials and buttons, flexible accordion-tube arms ending in grey pincer claws
spectators.idle: head tilting, antenna ball blinking, watching the ring
spectators.cheer: pincers raised high, chest dials flashing
spectators.shocked: sparks popping from the antenna, light-bulb eyes flashing wide

spectators.label: One-wheel dome robot
spectators.look: small white dome-headed robot with a single glowing blue visor band, a round white body with orange stripes and thin black extendable arms, rolling on one big black wheel, holding a tiny plain red pennant
spectators.idle: rocking back and forth on its wheel, visor scanning
spectators.cheer: pennant waved high, spinning on its wheel
spectators.shocked: visor flashing red, arms flung out stiff

spectators.label: Orange alien kid with a glow stick
spectators.look: small orange-skinned alien kid with a big round head, huge glossy black almond eyes and two curly antennae with glowing yellow tips, wearing a shiny silver jumpsuit and white boots, holding a bright green glow stick
spectators.idle: waving the glow stick slowly, antennae swaying
spectators.cheer: glow stick held high, antennae sparkling
spectators.shocked: antennae curled into tight spirals, mouth a tiny O

spectators.label: Three-eyed robed alien
spectators.look: lanky pale-blue alien with a long oval head, three calm violet eyes in a row and long thin fingers, wearing a flowing purple robe with a tall stiff gold collar and a glowing white gem on the chest
spectators.idle: long fingers steepled, studying the fight
spectators.cheer: long arms spread out wide to the sides, gem glowing bright
spectators.shocked: all three eyes wide open, fingers splayed

spectators.label: Horned alien mercenary
spectators.look: muscular brick-red-skinned alien with four short black horns along the brow and narrow yellow eyes, wearing a sleeveless silver scale-armor vest, a spiked black shoulder guard on one side, black trousers and a torn black cape
spectators.idle: arms crossed, judging the fighters with a sneer
spectators.cheer: fist out to the side, roaring with fangs bared
spectators.shocked: cape flaring back, eyes wide, horns tilted back

spectators.label: Bowler-hat blob alien
spectators.look: round squishy orange-pink gelatinous blob alien with one big central eye, a wide wobbly smile and two stubby arms, wearing a tiny black bowler hat and a red bow tie
spectators.idle: jiggling gently, eye fixed on the ring
spectators.cheer: stretching tall and wobbling, stubby arms up
spectators.shocked: body flattened like a pancake, eye huge, hat popping off

spectators.label: Giant steel android
spectators.look: hulking cobalt-blue steel android with a bucket-shaped head, a single horizontal red visor slit, riveted armor plates, massive shoulders and oversized three-fingered hands
spectators.idle: standing stiffly, visor light sweeping side to side
spectators.cheer: huge arms out wide to the sides, visor flashing
spectators.shocked: steam venting from the shoulders, visor flickering

spectators.label: Cyborg girl with a chrome arm
spectators.look: athletic cyborg girl with a violet high ponytail and a glowing cyan visor over her eyes, wearing a white-and-violet bodysuit with orange accents and short boots, her right arm fully chrome-robotic with glowing blue seams
spectators.idle: visor tapped with the chrome hand, scanning the fighters
spectators.cheer: chrome fist thrust up, seams glowing bright
spectators.shocked: visor flickering, hands raised in surprise

spectators.label: Fish-head alien in a water helmet
spectators.look: aqua-scaled alien with a goldfish-like head floating inside a round glass dome helmet full of water and bubbles, wearing a bulky orange spacesuit with white gloves and a small air tank on its back
spectators.idle: blowing bubbles inside the helmet, watching
spectators.cheer: gloved arms up, bubbles swirling wildly in the helmet
spectators.shocked: fish face pressed against the glass, mouth gaping

spectators.label: Four-armed insect alien
spectators.look: slim mantis-like green insect alien with big faceted red eyes, twitching antennae and four thin arms, wearing a beige poncho with an orange zigzag hem, holding a different snack in each of its four hands
spectators.idle: nibbling snacks from all four hands at once
spectators.cheer: all four arms raised, snacks held high
spectators.shocked: all four snacks dropped, antennae standing straight
